question: Which deities preside over the triad of circles?
premises: Brahmā is named as a presiding deity.
Viṣṇu is named as a presiding deity.
Rudra is named as a presiding deity of the three circles.
inference: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are the deities of the triad of circles.
plain_english: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are the deities of the three circles.
